title: channel.answered@1
description: An answer a channel returned counted, once the hub checked its proof: a paired device's signature, which is the trusted path, or an account link you made. It names the channel, so a later answer is refused naming it. Only the core appends it (#65).

subject.description: The ask this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

channel.description: The channel's name, as its plug-in registered it.

thread_key.description: The thread key: the item's handle, one thread per item on every channel.

proof.description: What proved it: a paired device's signature, or an account link the hub holds.

x-closure.closed: each value is a state the record defines and every reader acts on, so a value outside the list has no meaning
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema
